text:
emma: photo drop! Mochi discovered my stack of pancake plushies and insists on adding herself to the top. It's a canine soufflé. (pic attached) :pancakes: :dog:

raj: that is the fluffiest brunch i've ever seen. please tell me she accepted maple syrup as a tribute :maple_leaf:

emma: tribute was a single cheese cube. she is very discerning.

lydia: caption contest: 1) "Stacked and snacking" 2) "Mochi, the Breakfast Baron" 3) "Please pass the syrup" react 1/2/3 or reply other :yum:

ben: 2 for the regal energy. adding a tiny paper crown later.

photo-bot: emma added a file: mochi-pancake-stack.jpg (1.2MB)

raj: also important logistics: does anyone want a tutorial on how to make plush pancake props? low effort, high aesthetic.

emma: quick faux-recipe: felt circles, hot glue, tiny pompom butter, optional ribbon for extra dignity. took 20 mins.

lydia: making a note: pet prop crafting party next week? quick poll: saturday afternoon or sunday morning? react with :one: for sat, :two: for sun

ben: :one: -- afternoon vibes.

raj: :two: but will happily attend either.

emma: thanks folks. Mochi sends a single satisfied snoot and demands a ceremonial cheese cube for all votes. :heart_eyes:
